Benjamin Sinan WelchCommunicating for a Better World

Who Am I?

Hi! My name is Benjamin Sinan Welch. I have a Bachelor of Arts in Public Policy and Public Service, and a Master's in Development Studies from the Geneva Graduate Institute. Additionally, I have multiple years of experience working in communications roles for institutions and organizations such as Robert Kolej (Istanbul), Uniondale-Community Land Trust (New York), Oak Foundation (Geneva), Migration Policy Institute (Washington D.C.), and the World Meteorological Organization (Geneva). With this background, I bring an ability to not only deliver tangible products such as videos, photos, infographics, and events - but also to translate the complex, nuanced issues (and their solutions) our world faces today into clear, accurate, and engaging content for any audience.

Where Am I From?

I am a U.S. / Turkish citizen. Currently based in Istanbul.

Languages?

I speak English (fluent), Turkish (C1), and French (B2)

At the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), I participated in and managed several global social media campaigns for some of WMO's flagship products and most innovative initiatives.

This includes creating the content for the 2024 State of Climate reports, both global and regional. Moreover, as the Assistant Digital Communication Officer, I managed all WMO social media campaigns - including #EarlyWarningsForAll, #StateofWater, and #Glaciers2025. One of the most exciting campaigns I took part in was for the WMO Youth Action Plan - the #WMOYouth campaign. This included covering youth-centered events at WMO on social media, and helping organize the episodes, logistics, and promotional material for the newly launched podcast “Beyond the Forecast: Youth Conversations”.
